question_text: Which of the following is not the objective of the respiratory system?
option_a: Regulate the pH level of blood
option_c: Protection against the loss of blood
option_d: Has receptors for the sense of smell
explanation: The respiratory system supports management of blood pH and has receptors for the sense of smell. It also helps generate vocal sounds and filters inhaled air. Protection against loss of blood is not a respiratory-system function; this is related to circulatory function and blood clotting. The source explicitly identifies “Protection against the loss of blood” as the correct answer.
